title: AI Self-Creation Era Begins: "Godfather of AI" Hinton Warns the Most Dangerous Stage Is Approaching
source_used: 36Kr Europe (page carries a contributor disclaimer; interview credited to Nayeema Raza's programme)
key_facts: On 3 Oct 2026 Hinton reposted on X a paper by 22 top AI researchers, 'What if automating AI R&D triggers an intelligence explosion?'.
The paper cites Anthropic internal data: AI-written share of approved code rose from single digits in January 2025 to over 80% by May 2026.
The paper cites Claude doing about 1% of internal AI R&D work in March 2026 under high-level supervision, rising to 26% by August.
The paper deduces that, in extreme cases, a year of AI progress could take about 5 weeks.
Hinton says the time left to prepare regulation and safety mechanisms may be only one or two years, if AI keeps accelerating; he says he does not know how far recursive self-improvement has gone.
Hinton said a closed-door meeting with 19 US senators, mostly Democrats, made him slightly more optimistic, and he favours FDA-style approval for AI.
quote_evidence: So if I have to make a guess, I think the time left for us to prepare the regulatory system and establish safety mechanisms may only be one or two years.
Now I don't know if such things have really happened to that extent, but some AI are already like animals that have escaped from the fence.
why_it_matters_hint: A leading AI scientist warns the window to set safety rules may be short, grounded in a paper on AI automating AI research.
event_date: Interview date not stated; paper reposted 3 Oct 2026; 36Kr posted 8 Oct 2026
notes: The 36Kr page has a contributor disclaimer in Chinese, so the original reporter is unclear; credited as '36Kr, citing Nayeema Raza' per the 'X reports, citing Y' rule. Geoffrey Hinton's organisation is not stated in the article, so only his Nobel and AI-pioneer position is given. Headline overstated ('Self-Creation Era Begins'), score lowered 6 to 5 (-1).
